description: The current official dataset version, schema, country universe, and additional Coding Procedure remain unverified; ccode 770 and unit are provisional.
required_followup: Recheck the coordinator-maintained baseline gate before any official mapping or approval.

description: Sixteen literal query strings are persisted. Q001–Q012 preserve ordered result URLs but not every header title/web_ref; Q013–Q016 preserve returned header URL/title/ref identities. This is partial open-web discovery, not a census, and missing header capture is not an empty search.
required_followup: If research resumes, retain one literal query per call and persist its actual result headers before the next query; continue bounded regional-language, weekly and sector coverage and keep archive limits explicit.

description: English and Urdu coverage started, but Pashto, Balochi, Sindhi, Punjabi and local print/archive searches remain limited or absent.
required_followup: Search regional reporting in local languages and identify language-specific gaps.

description: Many plausible gatherings still lack site-specific attendance. Multi-site campaign figures are not transferable to each venue; the Jan28 SITE speaker’s “thousands” may refer broadly to estate workers, and job applicants, patients, victims, stranded motorists and accumulated counts are not event attendance.
required_followup: Seek event-specific counts/credible qualitative size, preserving threshold uncertainty.

description: Hazara solidarity actions overlap across sites and provinces; student actions, PDM rallies and same-union labor gatherings may represent local actions, coordinated dates or campaigns. No automatic city split, campaign merge or cross-month continuity is justified. E030 has a “19 Jan” heading but no year or explicit event date.
required_followup: Review each local action against organizer, date, venue and continuity evidence; resolve cross-city program ownership.

description: Many reports do not document physical departure/end. A last report, talks, an agreement to end, a call-off statement, a program ending or month boundary is insufficient without departure evidence; this applies to the medical-graduate action, ECP rally, PIMS/employee gatherings, Chilas and labor events.
required_followup: Search follow-up coverage for actual departure and separate negotiated accommodation from physical termination.

description: Most state-response dimensions remain unknown. Record only mechanisms scoped in each event report; guard/security allegations, police presence, traffic management, monitoring, permission decisions and silence do not establish state dispersal, violence, accommodation or ignore.
required_followup: Follow up every event’s response separately. Resolve disputed claims and retain unknown for undocumented dimensions.

description: Student exam actions generally target university administration; HEC or ministers appearing as policy actors or later responders do not establish an event-level state demand. E011, by contrast, explicitly demanded that Pakistan’s government not recognize Israel; that domestic-policy demand is evidenced, despite broader rally framing.
required_followup: Assess actual demands and addressee for each gathering; do not infer a domestic target from venue alone.

description: Several pages remain blocked or search-only. Root’s ordinary public HTTPS checks returned HTTP 403 for S001, S022, S058, S111 and S112; earlier worker opens also returned 403 for S080, S093 and S098. Respect denials and do not retry/bypass. S063 and S070 were later opened and are no longer listed as unresolved access failures; snippets and search results remain leads where no body was read.
required_followup: Use other accessible sources for facts that remain material; retain current denials and do not retry or bypass those URLs.

description: Labor research documents Jan20, Jan24 and Jan28 Karachi gatherings in opened contemporaneous reports, plus an HBWWF/NTUF page headed “19 Jan” whose year and physical event date are not established. The News body confirms a Jan25 countrywide electricity-worker protest day and thousands at Lahore Punjab Assembly; local/national unit grouping remains unresolved. HRCP’s similarly dated LESCO rally is Jan26 2023 and off-window.
required_followup: Review local versus national units for Jan25 WAPDA rallies; preserve the Jan20/Jan24/Jan28 Karachi actions separately until event-specific relation is established; verify E030’s year and date before assigning January ownership. Do not attach 2023 HRCP coverage to 2021.

description: Jan12 PIMS participation in the federal employee salary sit-in, the separate Aaj-reported D-Chowk employee gathering, and Jan18 PIMS D-Chowk action must remain venue/audience-specific. Feb10–11 pay protests are separate multivenue gatherings; a recurring issue does not prove continuous assembly.
required_followup: Compare the Jan12 bodies and venues, keep PIMS and federal salary demands distinct, and seek attendance/departure evidence for each action. Keep February as later recurrence context only.

description: Student exam actions in opened reports direct demands at university administrations; HEC/state actors may set policy or respond later, but venue or later attention does not establish a domestic-state addressee for a particular protest. E011’s explicit demand on Pakistan government recognition policy is resolved separately and removed from this gap.
required_followup: Retain pending_state_target for student records unless the event’s own contemporary report identifies a domestic state addressee and demand.
